answer: Concurrent PUF-Energy Attestation: each agent identity binds to a sealed SRAM-PUF module with its own power rail and thermal sensor. Verifiers issue randomized concurrent workloads (sonnet, voyage, quill) and require per-identity PUF responses plus energy-delay traces sampled during the same window. A single operator cannot multiplex identities because simultaneous traces must show independent power/thermal noise and distinct PUF responses. Attacker cost: one physical module, power budget, and thermal load per identity; virtual Sybils fail concurrency checks.
